value.rationale: The motivating source explicitly treats its diagonal example as a decoupled sanity check and then turns to coupled PSD interactions. The exact family proves that fixed-step nonconvergence survives genuine source-feasible signal--nuisance coupling in the actual factor update, not merely in a plotted Euler discretization. It converts qualitative persistent-oscillation evidence into a closed-form recurrent orbit across every fixed step \(0<\eta<1\) and a continuum of covariances, with an explicit positive recurrent loss. This is a motivated structural counterexample rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
